scope: Original 2017 base all nine species, Faderan reverse and full 2019 corroboration, accepted original printed components, contemporaneous direct designer originals. No Remastered, expansion, optional rules or module behavior.

clean_isolation.statement: No summaries, reader answers, grades, root coverage ledger/history, prior reviewer/audit/specialist reports, STATE/progress files or correction records were read. No collaboration, status or thread tools were used. Only the explicit five QA inputs and permitted original authorities/provenance were used as content. Embedded provenance status/history assertions were not treated as reviewer conclusions or rules authority. An initial filename-only AGENTS search found no current-workspace guide; no unrelated file content was read.
clean_isolation.temporary_artifacts: Only fitz PDF page renders /tmp/clean-sc-p1.png through /tmp/clean-sc-p10.png.

source_key.reason: All expected-answer propositions, 248 required atoms and contextual assertions checked against permitted original text, diagrams, scans/cards and direct author originals. No material source/key error found.

exact_asked_scope.reason: All 76 prompts checked independently against required facts and background. Required costs, actors, conditions, timing, exceptions and concrete calculations retained; premises and unasked parallel cases not credited as extra required atoms.

coverage_stopping.reason: Two current complete source-to-bank and bank-to-source procedural passes produced zero additions, followed by independent adversarial candidate challenge. No genuinely new source-supported core rule, outcome branch, consequential timing, priority or exception survived. All nine species and full Faderan reverse included; ordinary physical-card numerical values impose no all-card recall quota. No score cap or presumption of PASS used.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Unity native one-colony support count rather than a scenario supplied support limit
rejected_candidates.reason: Q47 does not ask native numeric support recall, and no such credit is claimed. Its excess-colony outcome is already asked; substituting another printed numeric support value adds no new procedure. Source Flexible Colonization matches the given scenario.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Kjas illustrated territory tile may run both economic converters
rejected_candidates.reason: The native card states this positively, but each distinct white converter may already run under Q06/Q76. Treating two converters on one tile as two activations adds no independent timing or exception; Q45 already asks all-purpose card status.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Ordinary Faderan relic loans explicitly return at turn end
rejected_candidates.reason: Species-background return rule expressly asked in Q03 applies; exception Gift Q42 and nontrade Detector Q62 separately asked. Replacing economic card name with ordinary relic is mechanical recombination.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Climate matching of an ordinary colony used as input
rejected_candidates.reason: Q28 climate is premise only, not separately asked. Q25 actual printed inputs and Q36 jungle input explicitly ask the matching-input constraint; Q47 and Q14 ask any-climate alternatives. A changed climate icon creates no distinct rule.

rejected_candidates.candidate: One VP entry on Grindstone or Transmutive Decomposer; their ordinary printed cube outputs
rejected_candidates.reason: Native accepted cards directly inspected. These are ordinary per-card entry/output quantities, not independent rules; no all-card numerical recall quota. Their exceptional point payment or simultaneous ship input rules are Q43 and Q06.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Transmutive Decomposer cannot consume freshly produced ships
rejected_candidates.reason: Explicit reverse statement applies universal simultaneous Economy rule asked by Q06.F05; ship substitution for another output is not new timing.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Cache discount for large rather than small cubes or another token count
rejected_candidates.reason: Source applies one fewer cube to small and large. Small asked Q39, numeric substitutions and same cube branch do not add novelty; ceil token calculation asked Q38.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Another Kjas even/odd split, ordinary bid tie, seeded-colony production or mixed final-scoring example
rejected_candidates.reason: Already asked split/rank/count/payment Q16/Q53, priority Q08/Q46/Q48, seedling production Q33, final grouping Q10/Q55. Cosmetic names/numbers or recombination.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Use scoring reminder arrows once only or skip final economic converters
rejected_candidates.reason: Q10 tests scoring all supplied groups and Q58/Q60 test actual final Economy. Primary designer original expressly calls scoring arrows formula reminders; no new contradictory procedure.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Final Envoys gift/token ruling contrary to ordinary donation retention
rejected_candidates.reason: Final donation retention already asked Q10, bundle rule Q49; sources supply no positive distinct final-token override. Do not invent a branch.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Optional timed Trade, handicaps, precise-resource fractions, designer suggested house rule omitting final theft, Remastered or expansion effects
rejected_candidates.reason: Outside original-base normative scope. Direct designer official answer distinguished from optional final paragraph.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Fiction, resource lore, species difficulty, strategy advice, component inventory and cosmetic handling
rejected_candidates.reason: No new rule-defined outcome or consequential timing/priority/exception.

delivery_notes: An initial oversized manifest delivery was superseded by complete bounded 0–5000–10000–13842 character responses; no decision relies on a truncated input.

Text ranges use Python read_text universal-newline Unicode characters; SHA256 and byte counts bind original file bytes. This explains extraction character count 29268 versus 29418 bytes and designer text Unicode byte differences.

Every bounded nested exec_command text output used adequate 4000-token cap (complete normalized chunk <=5024 characters plus short header); no original_token_count/output truncation event. Multi-call containers aggregate independent bounded nested responses, each fully inspected.

All images listed in the manifest were directly viewed, including ten species scans, both corroborating photos and thirteen accepted card crops; the PDF was additionally rendered and all ten pages viewed. Full2019 photo renderer reported resize from3024x4032 to2752x3669; relevant text remained legible.
limitations: Verdict covers the expressly permitted original-base corpus and procedural novelty standard. It is not a claim to test every numerical value on all physical cards or to resolve unsourced hypothetical combinations.
